summary: This is a Mustache template that shows different text depending on whether a configuration file exists. If the config_file variable has a value, it displays information about where to find the settings file; otherwise, it states that no configuration file exists.

explanations.2: The {{#config_file}} syntax means 'if config_file has a value, show everything until the closing tag'. It's a conditional check.
explanations.4: The {{ name }} and {{ config_file }} are placeholders that will be replaced with actual values when the template is rendered.
explanations.9: The {{^config_file}} syntax means 'if config_file is empty or doesn't exist, show this section instead'. The caret (^) inverts the condition.
